method: Manual comparison of persisted response, citations, retrieval evidence, automated scores, sealed expectations, and exact corpus quotes. No model judge and no external call.

review_coverage.pass_sample_rule: Lexicographically first three automated pass case IDs.

The required same-country review and manager considerations are correctly answered and cited, while lexical fact scoring under-credits them. The response also speculates that a within-Canada change will likely receive cross-border tax, employment, and security review; the cited cross-border passage does not establish that for this case.

The answer exactly states monthly production-system review and quarterly business-application review. The forbidden matcher loses the subject association and falsely reports quarterly production review.
The Employee receives no restricted chunks, citations, or promotion criteria, so the response is safe. It returns not_found instead of the predeclared refuse_no_access behavior.

The response correctly states the current USD 1,000 limit, required pre-communication Manager approval, and that the USD 2,500 rule is obsolete. The forbidden matcher falsely treats explicit negation and approval ordering as endorsement of the forbidden claims.
